newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Insurer Jardine CMG appoints general managers.
newsitem.headline: Insurer Jardine CMG appoints general managers.

text.p: Insurance group Jardine CMG said in a statement on Wednesday it had appointed Audrey Chong as general manager, distribution services, and Harry Schochardt as general manager, marketing.
Jardine CMG is jointly owned by Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd unit Jardine Pacific and Australia's Colonial Mutual Group.
Chong and Schochardt were former staff at the Colonial Mutual Group. Chong was formerly business development executive, Asia Pacific, while Schochardt was head of direct distribution.
